verdict.rationale: Weaviate's own llms.txt calls it an open-source vector database written in Go, and its source is hosted publicly at github.com/weaviate/weaviate. A community user independently confirms it is open source. Missing for 10: the specific license is not named in the evidence, and there is no first-party license or contribution documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Weaviate is an open-source vector database (Go) that stores objects, vectors, and inverted indexes
It is open source and fairly easy to get running locally
You can easily start Weaviate and a local vector embedding model with Docker.
